connection_condition: atom.molecule_id corresponds to molecule.molecule_id; an atom record cannot be interpreted without the molecule that owns it
description: A molecule is composed of its atoms; each atom belongs to exactly one molecule.

connection_condition: bond.molecule_id corresponds to molecule.molecule_id; a bond is always internal to a single molecule
description: A molecule is composed of its bonds; each bond belongs to exactly one molecule.

connection_condition: connected.bond_id corresponds to bond.bond_id; each bond is represented by two directed adjacency rows
description: A bond is represented in the adjacency table by the directed atom-to-atom records that share its bond_id.

connection_condition: atom.element holds the element value directly; no separate element table or element identifier exists
description: Every atom is characterised by one element value drawn from the observed set of lowercase element symbols.

connection_condition: bond.bond_type holds the bond order directly; no separate bond type table exists
description: Every bond carries one bond order value describing the multiplicity of the connection.

connection_condition: molecule.label holds the label value directly on the molecule row
description: A molecule is classified by one binary toxicity label, recorded only when the molecule has a row in the molecule table.

connection_condition: a bond links exactly two atoms of the same molecule; both endpoints appear as adjacency records sharing the bond_id, and the bond_id encodes the two endpoint indices
description: A bond connects two atoms within a molecule; it does not reference atoms outside its molecule and is not directional.
Molecular size is computed by counting the atom records that share a molecule identifier.
Bond count is computed by counting the bond records that share a molecule identifier.

Atom degree is computed by counting the distinct neighbours recorded for an atom in the adjacency table; because each adjacency is stored twice, counting rows and counting distinct neighbours differ by a factor of two.
